infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SafeLink needs your live GPS location to dispatch emergency services and share coordinates with your trusted contacts during an emergency.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: SafeLink needs access to contacts so you can quickly add and select trusted emergency contacts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SafeLink needs microphone access to record voice descriptions during an emergency SOS.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow SafeLink to track your coordinates for emergency dispatch.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow SafeLink to import emergency contacts from your phone.
